Title: Login with valid email and password
Preconditions: Registered, active user account exists
Steps:
1. Open the login page
2. Enter a valid registered email
3. Enter the correct password
4. Click Log in
Expected Result: User is authenticated and redirected to /dashboard

Title: Submit with empty email and password
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Leave email and password empty
2. Click Log in
Expected Result: Required-field errors are shown for both fields; no login request is sent; user stays on login page

Title: Submit with email only (password empty)
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter a valid email
2. Leave password empty
3. Click Log in
Expected Result: Password required error is shown; login is not attempted

Title: Submit with password only (email empty)
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Leave email empty
2. Enter a password
3. Click Log in
Expected Result: Email required error is shown; login is not attempted

Title: Login with wrong password
Preconditions: Registered user account exists
Steps:
1. Enter a valid registered email
2. Enter an incorrect password
3. Click Log in
Expected Result: Generic error such as 'Invalid email or password' is shown; user stays on login page

Title: Login with unregistered email shows same generic error
Preconditions: Email is not registered
Steps:
1. Enter an unregistered email
2. Enter any password
3. Click Log in
4. Compare the error with TC-005
Expected Result: Same generic error message and similar response time as TC-005, so it does not reveal whether the account exists

Title: Invalid email format is rejected
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter a malformed email
2. Enter a password
3. Click Log in
Expected Result: Validation error for invalid email format is shown for each value

Title: Account locks after 5 failed attempts within 15 minutes
Preconditions: Registered user account with no recent failed attempts
Steps:
1. Enter valid email with wrong password and submit 5 times within 15 minutes
2. Attempt a 6th login with the correct password
Test Data: Email: qa.user@example.com, Wrong: Wrong@999, Correct: Valid@1234
Expected Result: After the 5th failure the account is locked; the 6th attempt with the correct password is rejected with a lockout message

Title: 4 failed attempts do not lock the account
Preconditions: Registered user account with no recent failed attempts
Steps:
1. Submit wrong password 4 times
2. Submit the correct password
Expected Result: Account is not locked; 5th attempt with correct password logs in and redirects to /dashboard

Title: Failed attempts spread over more than 15 minutes do not lock
Preconditions: Registered user account; ability to control time or wait
Steps:
1. Submit wrong password 3 times
2. Wait more than 15 minutes
3. Submit wrong password 2 more times
4. Submit correct password
Expected Result: Account is not locked because only 2 failures fall within the latest 15-minute window; login succeeds

Title: Account unlocks after 15-minute lockout period
Preconditions: Account is locked as in TC-008
Steps:
1. Wait just under 15 minutes and try the correct password
2. Wait until 15 minutes have passed and try the correct password again
Expected Result: Attempt before 15 minutes is rejected; attempt after 15 minutes succeeds and redirects to /dashboard

Title: Remember Me keeps user signed in after browser restart
Preconditions: Registered user account
Steps:
1. Enter valid credentials
2. Check Remember Me
3. Log in
4. Close and reopen the browser
5. Open the application
Expected Result: User is still signed in and lands on /dashboard without logging in again; session cookie expiry is about 30 days

Title: Without Remember Me the session ends when browser closes
Preconditions: Registered user account
Steps:
1. Log in without checking Remember Me
2. Close and reopen the browser
3. Open /dashboard
Expected Result: User is redirected to the login page

Title: Remember Me session expires after 30 days
Preconditions: Logged in with Remember Me; ability to advance time or edit cookie expiry in test environment
Steps:
1. Advance time to 29 days and open /dashboard
2. Advance time beyond 30 days and open /dashboard
Expected Result: At 29 days the user is still signed in; after 30 days the user is redirected to login

Title: Password is masked and show/hide toggle works
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Type a password
2. Verify characters are masked
3. Click the show toggle
4. Click the hide toggle
Expected Result: Password is masked by default, shown as plain text after Show, masked again after Hide; typed value is unchanged

Title: SQL injection and script input are handled safely
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter injection payloads in email and password
2. Click Log in
Expected Result: Login fails with the generic error; no script executes; no database error or stack trace is shown

Title: Credentials are sent securely and not exposed
Preconditions: Browser developer tools open
Steps:
1. Log in with valid credentials
2. Inspect the network request and the URL
3. Inspect session cookies
Expected Result: Request uses HTTPS and POST; password is not in the URL or logs; session cookie has Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite flags

Title: Dashboard is not accessible without logging in
Preconditions: User is logged out
Steps: 1. Open /dashboard directly in the browser
Expected Result: User is redirected to the login page

Title: Email field trims spaces and ignores case
Preconditions: Registered user qa.user@example.com
Steps:
1. Enter the email with leading/trailing spaces and uppercase letters
2. Enter the correct password
3. Click Log in
Expected Result: Login succeeds (confirm expected behaviour with product owner if not specified)

Title: Login form is fully keyboard accessible
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Use Tab to move through email, password, show/hide toggle, Remember Me and Log in
2. Press Space on the toggle and checkbox
3. Press Enter to submit
Expected Result: Logical focus order, visible focus indicator on each control, all controls work by keyboard, Enter submits the form

Title: Screen reader announces labels and errors
Preconditions: Screen reader enabled (NVDA or VoiceOver)
Steps:
1. Navigate the form with the screen reader
2. Submit with empty fields
3. Focus the show/hide toggle
Expected Result: Fields have announced labels; errors are announced and linked to their fields; the toggle announces its state (e.g. 'Show password')
